stem:
Priya has two bar magnets on her study table at home.
She slowly brings the north pole of one magnet close to the south pole of the other magnet.
What will happen to the two magnets?

options.text: the two magnets will repel each other
the two magnets will attract each other
the two magnets will neither attract nor repel each other
both magnets will lose their magnetism

teacher.key_rationale: Unlike poles attract: the north pole of one magnet and the south pole of the other pull toward each other, so the correct answer is B. Option A is the trap for students who assume any two magnet poles push apart or that poles repel regardless of pairing.
